I am not an especially hairy person, but I love how epilating makes my legs, arms, and underarms so much smoother than shaving. However, I have PCOS which causes coarse hair to grow on my face and neck. The Emjoi pulls *most* of the hair on my face and only about half on my neck. Like I said, it hurts less than my other one did so I ordered another Remington Smooth & Silky EP6010 (which works great but hurts a bit more) and I'm going to u

I love this epilator. It did not hurt as much as I thought it would... I would suggest starting from a less hairy area then work your way to the more dense spots that way you will get used to the feeling. I am sort of addicted now. In the beginning I did it every 2-3 days until I got all of it and then it lasted longer till I had to epilate again.

reviews.t: I am pleased with my purchase on this epilator
reviews.x: I am pleased with my purchase on this epilator.  The first time you've used this there is some discomfort but not more than you can tolerate, the second time I used it was not as invasive as the first time. It did an  excellent job and I would highly recommend it. Just remember the first time you use it is the worst as far as discomfort.  It comes with a travel bag and is attractive in appearance. This would make a great gift.

reviews.t: Not the best, but a good choice
reviews.x: I like this epilator, although I was hoping it'd grab hair with less effort. I still have to run it on the same spot several times and it'll miss some hairs (nothing too concerning), which, with the amount of tweezers it has, one would think it wouldn't happen. I have noticed, however, lesser pain than with my previous epilator, which is always good!

I decided to give up shaving legs and underarms after 45 years of shaving, because of several scars from a broken ankle. I simply could not shave without also shaving off parts of the scars. Painful and lots of bleeding!  So I read a lot on line about epilators before I took the plunge and bought my very first one, Emoji eRase -60. The stinging sensation takes some getting used to, but it is almost a pleasant stimulation to me after a few uses. Woman who are use to having lip area and chin waxed can use the highest setting as it's less painful than waxing, in fact my skin is frail and they had to switch from liquid wax to hard wax. I'm a red head and following directions to clean your skin of any oils is important. I use a micro- fiber towelettes shaped li

reviews.t: Makes your skin as soft as waxing!
reviews.x: I love this product! Used on the back of my upper legs, it has been four weeks and the hair has barely grown back. After using it my skin is just about as soft as getting waxed! The only set back is I tried it on my armpits and it was really rough on the skin, didn't work so well with the coarse hair. Probably something to do with the fact that you can not pull the skin straight in that area. I would stick to using it on my legs and I am in love with it. No need for shaving cream or water.

reviews.t: I'm a pretty hairy dude and this thing made my shoulders as ...
reviews.x: Hey, this thing does exactly what it advertises, which is rip out your hair very quickly at 1000x a minute. I'm a pretty hairy dude and this thing made  my shoulders as smooth as...well, you get the picture.  I'm just a giant hairy baby and couldn't hack the pain. I tossed this thing out after neither myself nor my girlfriend gave it any use after 3-4 months.

The eRase e60 worked well on my lower legs. The upper lip not so much. It worked on my upper lip hair, but the pain was bad and I couldn't stop sneezing. My upper lip skin is too sensitive for the eRase e60 I now have a rash on my upper lip. My legs and underarms are great though! Very little hair breakage though.

reviews.t: If you tweeze or pluck your BODY hair, this is for you.

And because it pulls the hair out, I no longer have a 5 o'clock shadow when the hair grows back. I have also used it on my bikini area (which takes about as much time per square inch as my underarms) and on my legs (which for me takes longer to get every hair). I love how easy it is to use. It is  a great supplement for bet

Works a speck better if hair is at least maybe 4mm. This seems to break hair rather than pull it from the root, leaving short, stubby hairs, not smooth. I have tried every epilating tip-go slow, hot shower first, exfoliate, pull skin taught, etc. Works a speck better if hair is at least 4 mm long, but misses most hairs. I have gone over spots upwards of 60 or 70 times and one month later, I have only lost maybe 40% of hair.

I have mixed feeling about this product. I used it for a few weeks a little at a time and had no problems. It can be unpleasant but you get used to the feel after a few tries. If you do not exfoliate very,  very, well, you will end up with lots of ingrown hairs that will need to be plucked and pulled through the skin with tweezers. Not fun and not sure if I want to take the chance of having ingrowns.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the epilator effective on legs and finer hair, leaving skin smooth and soft.
Several reviewers note some discomfort or pain, especially on sensitive areas like the upper lip and armpits, though many say it lessens with repeated use.
Some reviewers report the device breaks hairs rather than pulling them out, or misses hairs and requires multiple passes.
Reviewers mention slower hair regrowth and reduced need for other hair removal methods after use.
A few reviewers find it less effective on coarse hair, such as facial or underarm hair.
